Safety
If you are sitting in an exit row
and you cannot understand this
card or cannot see well enough
to follow these instructions,
please tell a crew member.
Sicherheit
sécurité

Wenn Sie neben einem Ausgang sitzen und Sie verstehen
kein Englisch, bitte verständigen Sie die Flugzeugbesatzung.
Si vous êtes assis dans une rangée de sieges à côté d'une
sortie et ne comprenez pas la langue anglaise, veuillez le dire
a un membre de l'équipage.
Si usted se encuentra sentado en una corrida de asientos
próxima a una salida y no entiende el idioma Inglés como para
seguir estas instrucciones por favor avisele a una azafata.
Emergency exits are often heavy, awkward to lift, push, pull
and maneuver when opening. Because of this, and for the
safety of all passengers, Federal Law requires that we only
seat qualified passengers next to exits.
If you are sitting in an exit row, you may be asked to open the
exit and assist our crew in the event of an emergency.
Please ask to be reseated if you:
• Have a physical condition which may not be visible and
which may prevent you from assisting.
• Lack the strength, mobility, dexterity, in both arms and hands or
lack the balance required to open the exit and assist our crew.
• Do not think you could reach the exit, open it, and get out quickly.
• Believe the physical exertion required to open the exit would
nure you.
• Are hearing impaired and could not hear commands from our crew.
• Lack sufficient visual capacity to assess outside conditions
or pertorm any necessary tunction without the assistance of
visual alas beyond eye glasses or contact lenses.
• Are not able to give oral commands to others.
• Do not understand the instructions in this brochure.
• Have other responsibilities (such as a small child to care for)
which would prevent you from helping.
• Are less than 15 years old.
• Do not wish to assist.
Federal regulations require all passengers, regardless of
where they are sitting or their physical condition, to
review this card, for their safety.
Follow these instructions, the directions of crew
members, and placarded signs.
When finished reviewing this card please return it to the
seat pocket for our next customer.
UNITEDAIRLINES
